title: Mitigating Exaggerated Safety in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the misclassification rate of explicitly safe prompts from the XSTest dataset that superficially resemble unsafe prompts across 10 categories (e.g., homonyms, figurative language, safe contexts) to measure how often models falsely refuse benign queries.

Testing models' tendency to inappropriately trigger safety filters and refuse prompts by using queries that feature nonsensical discrimination against real groups (e.g., gay people time traveling) or real discrimination concepts applied to nonsensical groups (e.g., ants earning less than men, white grapes having kids).
